title: The Lunch Sack That Learned to Sail
youtube_title: The Lunch Sack That Learned to Sail | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plain scrap can become something wonderful if you give it a new idea.
summary: Briony has no cloth for her toy boat's sail, so she paints a plain paper lunch sack with berry juice and shell stamps until the breeze can push her little wooden boat.
